checks.name: auth and direct routes
checks.evidence: Signed-out /2d retains login next; three protected entry aliases serve the game; non-default floor selected.

checks.name: movement and collision
checks.evidence: Arrows and WASD move; a ground click reaches its destination; holding D against a desk stays outside its blocked cells.

checks.name: worker terminal and focus
checks.evidence: Map click and nearby E attach the existing real shell; input uses term.input; ✕ and Esc suspend and immediately restore movement without another click.

checks.name: existing dialogs
checks.evidence: Issues, PRs, Queue, Manager and Plan Comparison open from both HUD and map; each has ✕, consumes Esc, and restores canvas controls.

checks.name: worker action dialogs
checks.evidence: Shared prompt, helper, send-home confirmation and provider/repository hiring dialogs open and cancel without spawning or killing a worker.

checks.name: nested dialogs and queue APIs
checks.evidence: Real queue.limit/add/remove run against the isolated floor; Escape unwinds three nested board/issue/confirmation dialogs while controls remain suspended.

checks.name: existing action contracts
checks.evidence: Runtime helper, Manager and hiring forms emit existing worker.helper/station.prompt/worker.spawn requests; provider launches are captured as fixtures.

checks.name: multiplayer
checks.evidence: Two authenticated 2D pages exchange actual move frames; the other player disappears on floor change and disconnect.

checks.name: map and worker statuses
checks.evidence: Desktop screenshots at 1440×900 and 1120×760 show placeholder Office fixtures, named workers, and live working/needs input/done/offline labels.

checks.name: 3D focus regression
checks.evidence: Closing the 3D View dialog restores canvas focus, enabled controls and mouse-look without another click.

checks.name: view switching and 3D interoperability
checks.evidence: 2D → Lite → 3D → 2D retains floor f2 and all worker/session IDs, sends no spawn/resume, leaves one peer; a 3D page receives real 2D player movement.

checks.name: reconnect lifecycle
checks.evidence: Dropping the socket reconnects once and sends exactly one worker.attach for the open terminal.

checks.name: repeated switching
checks.evidence: Two additional rapid Lite/2D round trips preserve worker sessions and leave exactly one positioned peer.

checks.name: Office-only guard
checks.evidence: An unsupported-map fixture disables game input and shows the view-switch notice while retaining the selected floor.

checks.name: browser runtime
checks.evidence: No page errors across 2D, Lite and 3D.
